notes: Direct official local-assistant Open API adapter. Requires user.localassistant.readable and user.localassistant.invokable OAuth scopes. Token comes from WORKBUDDY_ACCESS_TOKEN or the per-user Windows DPAPI credential store. The workspace defaults to Documents/HarnessEval-WorkBuddy; authorize that folder in WorkBuddy. Override HARNESS_EVAL_WORKBUDDY_ROOT only when needed. Each run gets an isolated child directory. File tasks use local path references, not API attachment upload. Never put machine-specific paths or access tokens in this shared file.
